examples.title: User Authentication
examples.description: Implement OAuth2 login with Google and GitHub providers for secure user authentication
examples.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Users can log in with Google
2. Users can log in with GitHub
3. Session expires after 30 minutes
4. Invalid login shows error message

examples.title: Dashboard Charts
examples.description: Add interactive charts to the dashboard for sprint progress and team velocity visualization
examples.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Sprint progress chart displays correctly
2. Team velocity chart shows last 6 sprints
3. Charts are responsive on mobile devices

examples.title: Email Notifications
examples.description: Configure email notifications for sprint start, sprint end, and critical impediments
examples.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Email sent when sprint starts
2. Email sent when sprint ends
3. Email sent for critical impediments
4. Users can unsubscribe
